## ⛔ My file-surface assumption was wrong

I claimed this card's surface was "`content/docs/` — the data-migration page" and fenced it off from `cli.mdx`. **Verified myself on `origin/main`:** `grep -rln "Data migrations" content/docs/` returns **exactly one file — `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`**, and `grep -c duplicates` on it returns **0**.

⇒ **The card's only viable target IS `cli.mdx`.** There was no separate data-migration page to land in, so the boundary I drew made the card undeliverable rather than merely constrained. ✅ The dev did the right thing: it verified both premises, **stopped at the boundary, and edited nothing** — including creating no worktree, since a read-only measurement settled the outcome.

## ⭐ The work is not wasted — the row content is verified and recorded here

It read `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/duplicates.ts` (source + JSDoc) rather than trusting the card's prose, and confirms the card's suggested wording is **accurate** against the command itself:

- `static description`: *"Report business identifiers already minted twice across the organization partitions… Read-only inventory as JSON on stdout — never renumbers, deduplicates or rewrites anything. Run it BEFORE the #8686 tenancy backfill"*
- flags: `--object`, `--database-url`
- read-only boot (`deferSchemaDdl` + `readOnlyProbe`), pinned byte-identical by `duplicates.pre-repair.test.ts`
- **JSON-only output, no `--json` flag**

⇒ The next dispatch does not re-derive this. ⚠️ It should still re-check the implementation has not drifted.

## ⚠️ Part 2 of this card has no target that exists

The cross-reference half (point at the #8686/PR#8832 tenancy backfill "where it is described for operators") **has nothing to point at**: grepping `content/docs/**` for `__global__`, seed tenancy, tenancy split and `organization_id = NULL` finds **no operator-facing page describing that backfill at all** — it runs automatically at `kernel:ready` with no docs section. The only `__global__` hit is an unrelated `replace_unique_index` row, and `tenancy-modes.mdx`'s "Backfill for pre-existing users" is the **unrelated** membership backfill (`OS_SKIP_MEMBERSHIP_BACKFILL`).

⇒ **Part 2 is not deliverable as written**, independent of the file boundary. Whoever picks this up should either drop it or convert it into "document the backfill for operators first", which is a different card.

## Disposition — option A, ⛔ not B

The dev recommended **B** (bundle with #9342, disjoint sections of one file). ⛔ **Declining**: 「一单一 agent」 is a standing rule, and bundling two cards into one dev is exactly the shortcut it exists to prevent. The round-trip B saves is one rebase of a docs file with textually disjoint hunks — cheap.

**#9342 is dispatched now** (its blocker #9263 is closed — I verified the scaffolder change is on `origin/main`). This card goes back to the queue **blocked on it**, with the real serial recorded rather than the imaginary one I invented.
